entities.name: Norwood
entities.description: Elven forest covering much of northern Caliman on Dominaria, famed for featherwood trees.

entities.name: Talas
entities.description: People who harvested Norwood's featherwood to build ships, conflicting with the elves.

events.summary: Mass logging of featherwood by the Talas leads to conflicts between the Talas and the elves.
events.quote: This mass logging led to conflicts between the Talas and the elves.

relations.note: She is the elven queen of Norwood.
relations.quote: The elven queen of Norwood is Arathel .
